hunks.baseline: At Cheongpung’s astonished expression, the Fire King Jeok Cheongang gave him a faint smile.
hunks.sol: At the astonishment in Cheongpung’s eyes, the Fire King Jeok Cheongang smiled faintly.

hunks.baseline: “I heard you picked fights almost every day during the Great Faction War. Apparently, you beat up practically every young prodigy from the Nine Sects and One Gang…”
hunks.sol: “I heard you picked fights almost every day during the Great Faction War. Apparently, you got a good whack in on every last young prodigy of the Nine Sects and One Gang…”

hunks.baseline: “Ahem. Who says I beat up every one of them? And I was young back then. When you’re young and full of energy…”
hunks.sol: “Ahem. Whacked every one of them? Who says that! And I was young back then. When you’re young and full of energy…”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s body trembled after suddenly becoming a hidebound old man.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, suddenly turned into a hidebound old man, trembled.

hunks.baseline: The new waves of the Yangtze were stronger than he had imagined. Even so, he could not beat up the only grandson of his one kindred spirit…
hunks.sol: The new waves of the Yangtze were stronger than he had imagined. Even so, he could not beat up the only grandson of his one and only kindred spirit…

hunks.baseline: I opened my eyes with tears in them.
hunks.sol: I opened my eyes, holding back tears.

hunks.baseline: I might have been the first person here to realize his true identity.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t say for sure, but I was probably the first person here to realize his true identity.

hunks.baseline: The moment Jeok Cheongang’s internal energy surged into me, the System had delivered a meaningful message.
hunks.sol: The moment Jeok Cheongang’s internal energy came flooding into me, the System had delivered a rather telling message.

hunks.baseline: It had happened in the blink of an eye. At first, I thought I was about to be roasted alive. But soon my stomach grew warm, as if I had just eaten a bowl of gukbap,[^1] and my internal energy even increased.
hunks.sol: It had happened in the blink of an eye. At first, I thought I was about to be roasted alive like a whole pig. But soon my stomach grew warm, as if I had just eaten a bowl of gukbap,[^1] and my internal energy even increased.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t lie to this old man. You’d have better luck deceiving a ghost. I could tell the moment you opened your eyes.”
hunks.sol: “Like hell you’re not. You’d have better luck fooling a ghost than fooling this old man. I could tell the moment you opened your eyes.”

hunks.baseline: In reality, we had been locked in a relationship of killing or being killed. But I was not technically lying.
hunks.sol: In reality, ours had been a kill-or-be-killed relationship. But I wasn’t technically lying.

hunks.baseline: The atmosphere had become warm and friendly overall.
hunks.sol: The atmosphere had become warm and friendly overall. That is, until he opened his mouth again a moment later.

hunks.baseline: Then he opened his mouth again.
The family elders had vehemently opposed it, but Jin Wikyung had pushed it through. He had felt guilty about the mistake made by his grandfather, the former Family Head.
hunks.sol: The family’s senior members had vehemently opposed it, but Jin Wikyung had pushed it through. He had felt guilty about the mistake made by his grandfather, the former Family Head.

hunks.baseline: “Just a couple of months ago, unfortunately.”
A trace of anger appeared in Jeok Cheongang’s eyes.
hunks.sol: A flash of anger appeared in Jeok Cheongang’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: *Enough. Once I get out of here, I’m getting the hell out of here. Maybe I should just use Logout altogether.*
hunks.sol: *All right. The moment I get out of here, I’m gone. Maybe I should just use Logout altogether.*
